Part 1 — Admin Experience

🔐 Secure Access

Role-Based Login

Admins and operators each get their own tailored experience. One login — two completely different dashboards built for how each role actually works.

👷

Operator Dashboard

Field operators see only their assigned jobs, documents to complete, and navigation to job sites.

📊

Admin Dashboard

Office managers get full control — dispatching, scheduling, team management, and completed job tracking.

🏠 Command Center

Admin Dashboard

Everything your office needs in one place. Six modules covering the full lifecycle of every job — from dispatch to completion.

🚚

Dispatch & Scheduling

Create and manage job orders with an 8-step guided workflow.

📅

Schedule Board

View operator schedules and send notifications to the field.

👥

Team Management

Create accounts and manage who has access to what.

✅

Completed Tickets

View finished jobs with customer signatures and documents.

1 Step 1 of 8

Basic Information & Site Conditions

Select the job type, rate the difficulty, set priority, and capture critical site conditions. In this demo we're walking through a Slab Sawing job — the full system supports all 8 job types.

🔨

8 Job Types

Core Drilling, Wall Cutting, Slab Sawing, Wire Sawing, Concrete Demolition, Hand Sawing, GPR Scanning, and Shop Tickets.

📏

Difficulty Rating

1-10 scale helps match the right operator and estimate time accurately.

🅿️

Site Conditions

Truck parking, indoor/outdoor, and cleanliness — so crews know exactly what to expect.

2 Step 2 of 8

Work Details & Cut Specifications

Select materials, specify cut dimensions, and add multiple cut configurations. Every detail flows into a live preview so nothing gets missed.

🧱

Material Selection

Reinforced Concrete, Asphalt, or Green Concrete — blade selection depends on this.

📐

Cut Specifications

Linear feet or area-based with thickness. Add multiple cut sets per job.

👁️

Live Preview

Running summary updates in real-time as you fill out the form.

3 Step 3 of 8

Location Information

Enter the job site with Google Maps autocomplete. Drive time feeds directly into scheduling calculations.

📍

Google Maps Integration

Address autocomplete ensures accurate job site locations every time.

🚗

Drive Time Tracking

Estimated drive time automatically factors into shop departure scheduling.

4 Step 4 of 8

Schedule Information

Set dates, arrival times, and estimated hours. The system calculates when operators need to arrive at the shop based on drive time and buffer.

🧠

Smart Shop Arrival

Shop arrival = Job arrival − buffer − drive time. No more guessing.

⏱️

Buffer Options

30 min, 45 min, or 1 hour buffers for equipment loading and prep time.

📊

Estimated Hours

Track estimated vs. actual hours for profitability analysis over time.

5 Step 5 of 8

Team Assignment

Assign operators now or later. Coming soon — intelligent recommendations based on skillset, difficulty, and priority.

🤖

Smart Assignment (Coming Soon)

AI-powered matching based on operator skillset, job difficulty, and priority.

👤

Flexible Assignment

Assign immediately or defer — the system supports both workflows.

💼

Salesman Tracking

Every job linked to the salesman for commission and performance tracking.

6 Step 6 of 8

Required Equipment

The system recommends equipment based on job type. Click to add blades, guards, saws, and supplies — or search for custom items. No more showing up without the right gear.

⭐

Smart Recommendations

Recommended equipment auto-populates based on the job type — just click to add.

🔍

Custom Equipment

Search or type custom items for anything outside the standard list.

📋

Equipment Checklist

Selected items appear as a clear list — operators know exactly what to load.

7 Step 7 of 8

Customer & Job Information

Capture customer contacts, PO numbers, company info, and the quoted price. This data feeds into profitability tracking — revenue vs. direct labor costs on every job.

💰

Profitability Tracking

Quoted price per job to calculate margins against actual labor and equipment costs.

📧

Automated Notifications

Customer email gets signed completion agreements. Salesperson notified when jobs finish.

📋

Complete Records

PO numbers, GC info, on-site contacts — everything stored and searchable.

PART 2

The Operator Experience

A mobile-first workflow that takes operators from clock-in to customer sign-off — every step documented, every minute tracked, every document archived.

Clock In → Schedule → Route → Liability → Silica → Work Log → Sign-Off
Onboarding

Guided Welcome Tour

First-time operators get an 8-step guided walkthrough showing them every feature — Job Schedule, Timecard, Leave Requests, Quick Actions, and more. No training manual needed.

🎯Step-by-step tour — 8 guided steps with progress bar
📅Job Schedule — Today's assignments at a glance
⏰Timecard — Hours tracking and attendance
⚡Quick Actions — Clock Out, Notifications, Stats
Dashboard

Command Center

Everything at a glance — active jobs, hours worked today, clock status. GPS-verified clock-in ensures operators are physically at the shop before starting their day.

📍GPS-verified clock in — Must be within 20ft of shop
📊Live stats — Active jobs count and hours today
🔔Smart alerts — Clock out reminder after shift
🔒Coming soon — Tool management module
Schedule

Daily Job Schedule

Operators see exactly what's on their plate — job type, customer, location. Navigate between days or jump to any date. One tap opens the complete ticket preview with every detail they need.

📅Date navigation — Previous, Next, or jump to date
🎫Job cards — Type, customer, and location at a glance
👆One tap — Opens full ticket with all job details
Ticket

Complete Ticket Preview

Everything an operator needs before heading out — arrival times, site conditions, job specs, equipment checklist, and priority level. Full address stays hidden until they start the route.

⏰Dual arrival times — Shop arrival + job site arrival
📍Site conditions — Parking, environment, cleanliness, difficulty
📝Full specs — Material, dimensions, accessibility rating
🔧Equipment checklist — Every tool verified before departure
Route

In Route & Arrival

Once equipment is verified and route starts, the full address is revealed with one-tap directions. The on-site contact gets an automatic SMS with the operator's ETA. Arrival is logged when they tap "Start In Process."

📍Address revealed — Full location shown only after route starts
📱Auto SMS — Contact notified with ETA automatically
🗺️Get Directions — One-tap navigation to job site
📞Tap to call — Contact info with direct dial
▶️Start In Process — Logs arrival time and proceeds to liability
Legal

Liability Release & Indemnification

Before any work begins, the customer must sign the liability release on the operator's device. Covers layout assistance, limitation of liability, underground utilities, site conditions, and indemnification. No signature — no work starts.

🛡️Full legal protection — Layout errors, utilities, site conditions covered
✍️Electronic signature — Customer signs on device with timestamp
📄Auto PDF — Signed agreement emailed to customer instantly
🔒Required step — Cannot proceed without signature
OSHA

Silica Dust Exposure Plan

OSHA-compliant Silica Dust/Exposure Control Plan — employee info auto-filled, work type selection, exposure control questions (water delivery, location, cutting time, respiratory protection), and electronic signature. All per Table 1 standard 1926.1153.

📋Auto-filled info — Employee name, phone, crew from profile
🔧Work type — Hand Saw, Core Drilling, Wall Saw, Slab, Jack Hammer
🌊Exposure control — Water delivery, ventilation, cutting duration
⏸️Standby button — One tap to track all wait time for billing
Review & Sign

Document Summary & Archive

Complete summary of all silica form data — employee, work type, water delivery, location, cutting time, APF 10 status. OSHA compliance reference included. Electronic signature converts the form to PDF and saves it to the completed jobs archive.

📊Full summary — Every field reviewed before signing
📜OSHA reference — Table 1 standard 1926.1153 cited
📄Auto PDF — Converts to PDF and saves to job archive
🗂️Job archive — All documents accessible for audits
Work Log

Work Performed

Operators log exactly what they did — select from work types (Core Drill, Slab Saw, Wall Saw, Hand Saw, Chain Saw, Break & Remove, Jack Hammering), then fill in linear feet, blade sizes, and notes. Quick Entry makes multi-cut input fast.

🔍Search or browse — Quick Add from popular work items
⚡Quick Entry — Fast multi-cut input with auto-calculation
🔪Blade tracking — 20" to 72" Diamond plus custom sizes
📊Profitability data — Actual vs. quoted for better future estimates
Feedback

Operator Job Feedback

After submitting work, operators rate the job from their perspective — difficulty level and site access quality with emoji ratings. This feedback helps improve future estimates and flag problem sites.

😊Difficulty rating — Very Easy to Very Hard with emoji scale
✅Site access rating — Excellent to Very Poor
📝Optional details — What made it easy/hard, access issues
📊Data-driven estimates — Real field data improves future pricing
Detail Entry

Slab Saw Detail Form

Each work type gets its own smart form. For Slab Saw — total linear feet, cut depth, Quick Entry for multiple cuts, chainsaw checkbox, steel cut tracking with rebar type, and blade size selection from 20" to 72" Diamond plus custom sizes.

📏Linear feet & depth — Direct entry or Quick Entry for multiple cuts
⚡Quick Entry — Batch input: number of cuts × length × depth
🔪Blade tracking — 20" to 72" Diamond + custom sizes
🔩Steel cut tracking — Rebar type documentation (#4, #5, etc.)
Blade & Cut Log

Added Cuts & Blade Tracking

Each cut entry is logged with specs — 1,000 linear feet, 8" deep, Steel Cut #4, 24" Diamond blade. Entries can be edited or deleted. Custom blade sizes supported. Additional notes field for anything extra.

📋Cut summary — LF, depth, steel type, blades all visible
🗑️Edit/delete — Modify entries before final submission
➕Custom blades — Add non-standard sizes as needed
📝Additional notes — Free text for special circumstances
Submitted

Work Items Confirmed

All work items tagged and confirmed — SLAB SAW (x1000) and BREAK & REMOVE (x1500) with quantities. Operators can add more work types or submit. All data feeds directly into job costing and profitability analysis.

🏷️Tagged items — Work types with quantities as removable tags
➕Add more — Select additional work types if needed
✅Submit — Finalize and proceed to photos/signature
Documentation

Job Site Photos

Upload photos of completed work, equipment, or site conditions for quality control and documentation. Optional step — operators can skip and proceed directly to customer signature. Photos are stored in the job archive.

📸Photo upload — Capture completed work from device camera
⏭️Optional step — Skip or continue, both go to signature
🗂️Archived — Photos stored with all job documents
Customer Sign-Off

Job Data & Work Summary

All job data loaded for customer review — job ID, customer, location, original scope, and actual work performed with full specifications. Customer hits "Complete Job & Get Signature" to begin the 4-step Service Completion Agreement.

📋Complete record — Original scope vs. actual work side by side
✅Verified data — SLAB SAW 1000 LF, BREAK & REMOVE 1500 sqft
📄4-step agreement — Summary → Terms → Payment → Signature
Terms & Feedback

Completion Terms & Customer Survey

Customer confirms work status — satisfactory, needs correction, or contact not on site. Then a quick feedback survey (customer only — operators warned not to fill it out). Site cleanliness, communication, and overall experience rated 1-10.

✅Work acceptance — Satisfactory / Correction / No contact
⚠️Operator notice — Bold warning: customer feedback only
⭐Performance ratings — Cleanliness, communication, experience
💬Comments — Optional free-text feedback
Legal

Payment & Liability Terms

Both agreements must be accepted before proceeding. Payment terms (due upon completion, 1.5% monthly finance charge, collection costs) and full Liability Release & Indemnification (underground utilities, site conditions, limitation of liability).

💰Payment terms — Due on completion, finance charges, collection fees
🛡️Full liability coverage — Utilities, site conditions, indemnification
☑️Dual acceptance — Both checkboxes required to proceed
⚠️Legal notice — Binding agreement warning before signature
Complete

Final Signature & PDF Archive

The final step — customer name, title/position, electronic signature. Agreement summary confirms all terms accepted. On submit, the entire Service Completion Agreement converts to PDF and is saved to the completed jobs archive alongside every other document from the job.

✍️Electronic signature — Legally binding with timestamp
📄Auto PDF — Complete agreement converted and emailed
🗂️Full archive — Liability, silica, work log, sign-off — all stored together
🔒Job complete — Status updated, office notified, records sealed

This is just the beginning.

Everything you've seen is fully customizable to how your company operates. Different job types, documents, workflows — this software adapts to you, not the other way around.
